text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear opening stance with a present-tense claim about driverless cars not being a higher lead","quality":"clear thesis","description":"The essay states its position early and makes the argument it will defend easy to identify."},{"evidence":"Paragraph on sensors and incomplete autonomy","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay more directly incorporates details from the article to support its points about current limitations."},{"evidence":"“However, some people might argue…” rebuttal paragraph","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges an opposing view and responds to it instead of only repeating its own opinion."},{"evidence":"Intro body conclusion structure with transitions like “However” and “As of right now”","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly divided into argumentative sections and moves between ideas more smoothly."},{"evidence":"Focus on technology being useful but not yet necessary","quality":"argument focus","description":"The essay keeps a consistent central claim and does less drifting into unrelated ideas than the other essay."}]}
